decisions.evidence: Combined raw 351 vs ~860 expected; 334 has AM peak 23-36/slot then 42 consecutive slots of 0 apart from two 1s; 335 likewise; evening slots resume at normal levels; 2018-06-19 was also low (336) suggesting wet weather.

series.name: Bourke St northbound (citybound), EcoCounter 2016-2025
series.evidence: Original EcoCounter piezo, North direction (AM peak 08:00).

series.name: Bourke St southbound, EcoCounter 2016-2025
series.evidence: Original EcoCounter piezo, South direction (PM peak 17:00).

series.name: Bourke St northbound (citybound), MetroCount 2025-
series.evidence: Replacement MetroCount MC5920 after a 5.5-month gap; same North/AM-peak profile as 334 but reads ~25-44% higher year-on-year (e.g. Mar 2026 1084/day vs Mar 2025 866), more than independent neighbours Anzac Pde (+16%) and Alison Rd tube (+12-19%) though similar to Moore Park Rd tube (+35-48%), so comparability cannot be confirmed; kept separate.

series.name: Bourke St southbound, MetroCount 2025-
series.evidence: Replacement MetroCount, South/PM-peak profile matching 335; level ~30% above the old counter with a gap between, so kept separate for the same reason as northbound.

summary: Bourke St (W) N of Thurlow St cycleway: EcoCounter 225 (2016-05 to 2025-05, 4 channels per direction) replaced by MetroCount 363 from 2025-10; the automatic fixes (long zero outages in 2019, 2020-21 and 2023, two corrupt spike days, and 2022-2024 duplicated records) are correct. Between Sep 2017 and Mar 2018 the old counter repeatedly dropped out for the afternoon/PM peak, which the automatic fixes missed, so 58 such days are set missing; 2018-06-20 is uncertain. The new counter reads 25-44% above the old one after a gap, more than most independent neighbours grew, so old and new counters are kept as separate series.
